ambiguous_query_handling.detail: Ambiguous input ('What happened yesterday?') returned structured clarifications and domain suggestions.

mutation_blockage.detail: Destructive SQL keywords (DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE, DELETE) strictly blocked by AST validator.

rbac_enforcement.detail: Unauthenticated denied 401; Viewer restricted from raw logs 403; Admin granted 200.

commercial_egress_firewall.detail: Attempted egress to public OpenAI endpoint strictly blocked by air-gap firewall policy.
